svg.text: Region ap-south-1 · one SAM stack · the sandbox lives in a VPC with no way to the internet
SANDBOX VPC · no internet gateway · no NAT · no credentials inside

g.text: A request comes in from the CLI, the AI agent or the website, and the cache is checked.
Seen before? The answer comes straight back in milliseconds.
Not seen? A scan starts through Step Functions.
The scanner fetches the package, asks threat intel, reads the code and asks a model.
The package is run in the sandbox: no internet, watched at the network and kernel level.
What the sandbox saw is written to S3 through a private endpoint.
The report goes to S3, the verdict to DynamoDB, and everyone after gets it instantly.
